the kinetic model of electromagnetic and gravitational radiations is a useful model for studying the global properties of radiation damping, and that it is a good model for studying the properties of radiation damping in the limit of large particle number.

(i) the kinetic model for electromagnetic and gravitational radiation is a model of the radiation field and not a model of the particles; (ii) the model is not a model of a single particle, but a model of an ensemble of particles; and (iii) the model is a model of a system in which the particles are in equilibrium with the radiation field.
